analysis: This batch contains only documentation changes: removal of docs/architecture/components/console-ui.md, removal of 11 console-redesign screenshot JPEGs, and edits to docs/developer/build.md that drop the retained-console build section, the `make ui-install ui-build` step and the `lint-console` CI routing row. No executable source, provider code, protocol handling, key custody, attestation, cache storage, fan helper or add-on hold socket is touched, so none of the provider/native-runtime threat entries (TB-002/003/007/009/010/011/012, T-041 etc.) are affected by control changes. The removed console doc described console-ui behavior (server-side relay, Privy/API-key credential paths, CSP, optional browser sealing, telemetry disabled, GA consent default granted, mock-auth caveat). Console is outside the stated in-scope for this provider threat model (out_of_scope: consumer console), and the build.md edit states console builds belong to the platform repo. I saw no evidence that the console source or hosting configuration is removed in this PR; only the documentation is. The security-relevant notes in the removed doc (mock auth must not ship, GA consent defaulting to granted) are lost from this repo's docs, but that is documentation drift for an out-of-scope component rather than a regression in a provider control, and the platform repo is the stated owner. Remaining integration question: if console-ui/ source or CI (`lint-console`) still exists elsewhere in the PR, removing its CI lint lane could reduce checks, but that is not visible in the supplied units and is not evidence of a regression here. No findings.
